Subject: PO requirements and invoice cadence question

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our product team was impressed with the latency and the billing demo you ran. Procurement asked me to confirm a few items before we proceed with the PO:

- We need Redwood to accept a consolidated PO that references multiple workstreams and to receive weekly invoices (every Friday) rather than monthly statements. Is that supported?
- Our finance team requires Net45 terms; I saw standard Net30 in the proposal. Can Redwood make a Net45 exception for HealthBridge?
- Any required PO fields (cost center, BU code, GL mapping) we should include to avoid rejections in our ERP? Please attach a PO template if you have one.

We can escalate if necessary but wanted to check availability and any impacts on pricing/discounts if we change cadence or terms.

Appreciate the quick turn here — procurement is hoping to finalize the PO in the next two weeks.

Best,
Ellen

HealthBridge Medical Network

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence question

Hi Ellen,

Thanks — glad the demo was helpful. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Consolidated PO + weekly invoices: we can accept a single PO that covers multiple workstreams. We support weekly invoices but need a stable PO reference and clear invoice line mapping so your AP system can reconcile. That is typically handled via two things on our side: a PO reference on each invoice and an invoice "lane" name matching the workstream.

2) Net45 terms: we can make a Net45 exception, subject to a signed amendment tied to the PO (finance needs the amendment to record the extended term). There is a small administrative charge for Net45 exceptions when combined with weekly invoicing; I’ll outline the options below so you can choose what’s lowest friction.

3) Required PO fields: please include PO number, billing contact email, three-letter BU code (if you use one), and the GL code mapping where possible. I’ve attached our PO template (Redwood_PO_template.pdf) and a clean SOW for reference (SOW-Redwood-Healthbridge-2026.docx).

Options (pricing/ops impact):
- Option A (no fee): Keep Net30 + weekly invoices — standard discount tier applies.
- Option B (+0.75% admin fee): Net45 + weekly invoices — requires the amendment; discount tier will be grandfathered for this deal.
- Option C (+1.25% admin fee): Net45 + weekly invoices + split-month invoicing (we produce weekly invoices but consolidate settlement monthly) — helps your AP batching.

Next steps: if you can confirm which option HealthBridge prefers I’ll loop in Karthik (payments/enterprise onboarding) and Vanessa (contracts) to prepare the amendment and finalize the PO field mapping. If helpful, we can also do a 20-minute call with your AP team this week.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Manager, EMEA & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_PO_template.pdf, SOW-Redwood-Healthbridge-2026.docx

Ellen — thanks, Option B is fine. A couple of operational notes and timeline so procurement and finance have clarity: 

- Amendment: Yes, the Net45 amendment needs to be signed before the first invoice is issued under Net45. Vanessa will prepare the amendment and send it as an addendum to the MSA; turnaround is typically 48 business hours once we have the signed PO and the completed PO template.
- BU field: we can accept a custom BU field ("BU:HB-RND"). Please include it in the PO metadata and we’ll map it in our invoicing pipeline.
- Invoice labeling: to keep your ERP happy, please ensure each invoice line includes: PO#, BU:HB-RND, Workstream name, and our internal invoice lane. We’ll produce weekly invoices on Fridays starting the first full Friday after the amendment is signed.
- Admin fee: the +0.75% admin fee will be applied as a separate line item on each invoice (we can show it as "Finance admin adjustment"). If Finance prefers a one-time setup fee instead, Karthik can propose an alternative structure.

Actions:
1) I’ve attached the blank PO template — fill PO#, BU code, billing contact and return to me.
2) Vanessa will follow up with the amendment and updated SOW reflecting billing cadence.
3) Karthik, can you prepare the alternative one-time fee option (if HealthBridge prefers) and join the AP call Tuesday at 10:00 AM PT?

Ellen, please send the filled PO template to me and to procurements@healthbridge.org and I’ll get Vanessa to kick off the DocuSign.

Thanks — look forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
